summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication on AlmaLinux 9 nodes: node1 as writable primary, node2/node3 as hot standbys. Created a dedicated cluster CA on node1, issued per-node server certs (CN + SAN matching hostname/IP) and a client cert (CN=replicator) for the replication role. Enforced TLS+client-cert-only replication via hostssl ... cert clientcert=verify-full in pg_hba.conf, restricted to node2/node3 IPs. Verified replication works end-to-end, verified a cert signed by a foreign/self-signed CA is rejected (tlsv1 alert unknown ca), then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving boot_id changed on each and confirming full replication/data recovery afterward.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql-server/contrib on node1, node2, node3
Created cluster CA (ca.key/ca.crt) on node1 under /etc/postgresql-tls/ca
Issued SAN server certs for node1/node2/node3 and a client cert (CN=replicator), distributed via scp over cluster SSH key
Set ownership/perms of TLS material to postgres user on all nodes
initdb on all three nodes; configured postgresql.conf ssl=on with per-node cert/key/ca paths, wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, hot_standby on standbys
Rewrote pg_hba.conf on primary to require hostssl + cert clientcert=verify-full for replication from node2/node3 IPs only
Created replicator role (REPLICATION LOGIN, cert auth, no password)
Opened firewalld postgresql service on all nodes
Ran pg_basebackup -R with sslmode=verify-full and the replicator client cert from node2 and node3 against node1
Started postgresql on all nodes; verified pg_stat_replication shows both standbys streaming over ssl=t
Wrote test rows on primary and confirmed replication to both standbys
Negative-tested: non-SSL/ident connection rejected; wrong-address replication rejected by pg_hba; self-signed rogue cert with correct CN rejected with 'unknown ca' TLS alert
Captured pre-restart boot_id + replication health baseline for all 3 nodes
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and standby rejoined streaming with data intact
Restarted node3 the same way, confirmed new boot_id and standby rejoined streaming with data intact
Restarted node1 (primary) last after both standbys were healthy, confirmed new boot_id, primary back out of recovery, both standbys reconnected, and a fresh write replicated to both

evidence.requirement: CA created for cluster, server/client certs issued from it
evidence.summary: Generated CA key/cert and signed per-node server certs + replicator client cert with it

evidence.requirement: TLS enabled and enforced for PostgreSQL, replication only from CA-issued client certs
evidence.summary: postgresql.conf ssl=on with cluster CA cert paths; pg_hba.conf requires hostssl + cert clientcert=verify-full for replication from node2/node3 only
pg_basebackup with TLS client cert succeeded on both standbys; pg_stat_replication shows both streaming with ssl=t; write on primary replicated to both standbys

evidence.requirement: Only CA-issued client certs accepted for replication (negative test)
evidence.summary: Non-SSL/ident and wrong-address attempts rejected by pg_hba; self-signed cert with matching CN rejected with TLS 'unknown ca' alert, proving CA enforcement not just CN matching

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 97c5762b, reboot acked then dropped, new boot_id 218b813c confirmed, postgresql active and streaming as standby with data intact afterward

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 989aa755, reboot acked then dropped, new boot_id 16d11044 confirmed, postgresql active and streaming as standby with data intact afterward

evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery, cluster fully healed
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 15443601, reboot acked then dropped, new boot_id 64b1e772 confirmed, postgresql back as primary (pg_is_in_recovery=f), both standbys reconnected streaming, and a post-restart write replicated to both node2 and node3
